easyPrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
description:
Animate the land that has Squirrel Nest attached using Jolrael.
Activate the land with Squirrel Nest attached by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.name: Squirrel Nest
uses.cardState: attached to a land that does not have summoning sickness
